# Syntyr CSS 0.3.0-alpha.4 — immutable published CSS reference

> This index describes the published v0.3.0-alpha.4 CSS assets only. It does not imply later source-tree components, themes or examples are included. Syntyr is CSS, not a JavaScript component library.

## CSS assets

- [Core stylesheet](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/v/0.3.0-alpha.4/syntyr.core.css)
- [Recipes stylesheet](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/v/0.3.0-alpha.4/syntyr.recipes.css): Optional application/website compositions.
- [Semantic stylesheet](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/v/0.3.0-alpha.4/syntyr.semantic.css): Optional opt-in native element styling; load after core.
- [Effects stylesheet](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/v/0.3.0-alpha.4/syntyr.effects.css): Optional.
- [Geometry stylesheet](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/v/0.3.0-alpha.4/syntyr.geometry.css): Optional.
- [All-in-one stylesheet](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/v/0.3.0-alpha.4/syntyr.all.css): Do not load alongside its individual modules.

## Valid themes and scoping

The only published themes for this release are `studio`, `grid` and `noir`. Wrap styled markup in `.syn-root`, and set `data-syn-theme` on that root or a nested themed subtree. Use only selectors actually defined in your installed module(s).

Example:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/v/0.3.0-alpha.4/syntyr.core.css">
<main class="syn-root syn-page" data-syn-theme="studio">
  <h1 class="syn-heading">Dashboard</h1>
  <p class="syn-muted">Welcome back.</p>
</main>
```

Syntyr does not implement form submissions, state management, CRUD, authorization, chart rendering or advanced keyboard widget behavior. Implement those in the host application and verify browser accessibility.

For instructions on using the published release with coding agents, consult the [version-aware quickstart](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/docs/ai-quickstart.md), but ignore any sections explicitly labeled unreleased or source-only. The [main index](https://syntyr-css.pages.dev/llms.txt) points to current source-candidate documentation, not this release's immutable API.
